sites.name: Pod R3 (Șos. Hîncești) peste Centura M2, nod Codru

bridges.evidence: img/s00.jpg, s00z.jpg, s00z_crop.jpg (Esri). Twin decks ~80 m, abutment cones visible; piers not visible top-down. Deck heights ≈ DEM (game deck is OK) — the error is the road UNDER it, which the game keeps at DEM ≈11 so it runs through the deck. Deck/clearance values are ESTIMATES (shadow + grade reasoning). | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): deck = DSM + 1.6 m (decks read ~1.6 m low at 30 m, measured on the Grădina Botanică decks).

earthworks.evidence: R3 runs on a 9–13 m embankment the DEM opening filter erased | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): line = DSM (5-point median); one continuous line so there is no dip between pieces.
DSM shows R3 on fill here, not in a cutting | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): line = DSM.

ESTIMATE from geometry: deck top ≈7.3 m above M2 (deck shadow 4.4 m perpendicular vs bus shadow 1.5 m for ~3.2 m bus on same image, img/s00z_crop.jpg → 7-8.5 m); R3 cannot sit higher than DEM (grade). Bare sandy cut slopes visible W of M2 (img/s00.jpg x≈-6000, z 6620-6900). M2 comes up the Bostancea floor (DEM 1.8 at z 6396) so a ~0.5 % grade into the cut is natural. | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): shifted +5.1 m so M2 is 7.5 m under the DSM deck (agent clearance kept, anchor was low).

ESTIMATE: loop OSM 25452919/25452920 must climb from the M2 under the bridge to R3; linear ~5.5 % ramp, capped at DEM. | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): shifted +5.1 m so M2 is 7.5 m under the DSM deck (agent clearance kept, anchor was low).

sites.name: Barajul lacului de pe Ișnovăț (Șos. Hîncești R3 pe coronament)

earthworks.road: Șoseaua Hîncești (R3) on the reservoir dam crest
earthworks.evidence: img/r3isn.jpg, r3sw.jpg: R3 runs ~750 m along a dam, lake on the NW, concrete-faced upstream slope with parked cars; Ișnovăț leaves through a 120 m culvert under it (OSM 110296525) and a 212 m retaining wall (OSM 84557769). DEM: lake surface -7.2, downstream floodplain -10…-13, but the DEM under the road is -7.7 (grey-opening erased the dam). Crest = lake + 3.2 m freeboard is an ESTIMATE (±1.5 m). Upstream face ~1:2.5 concrete revetment to the water; downstream face to ~-10…-12. ALSO: the lake water surface in game must be -7.2 (not the lowest shore DEM, which reads ≈-8 on the erased dam). | DSM-corrected 2026-11-20 against Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (TanDEM-X 2011-15, 30 m): crest = DSM (7-point median), never below the old estimate.

sites.note: Not a bridge; the most visible earthwork in the area. First ~6 points are the R3 descent from Codru plateau at 6 % (ESTIMATE).
